newsitem.title: UK: Bumper harvest weighs on UK grain futures.
newsitem.headline: Bumper harvest weighs on UK grain futures.

text.p: Bumper harvests in the UK and France weighed on UK grain futures on Monday.
"The market looked at unchanged when it opened but the pressure from the harvest proved too much in the end," said a trader.
Wheat futures closed one to 0.50 stg down after trading 662 lots while barley was 0.30 to 0.45 stg lower on a turnover of 110 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures closed unchanged after trading six lots.
Trade on the UK cash markets was thin although fob traders reported December feed wheat trading at 110.50 stg a tonne ex-east coast ports.
Delivered buiness was "fair" with traders reporting Oct/Dec milling wheat in the Liverpool area fetching 134.50 stg while 130 stg was paid in London.
Feed wheat in East Anglia traded at 107 stg for Sep and from 110.50 down to 109 stg for Oct/Dec.
In the Avon range 110 stg was paid for Oct/Dec.
Feed barley in East Anglia traded at 102 stg for Sep and 105.50 and 105 stg for Oct/Dec.
